ceu: ✦ The conjunction between Mars and Jupiter

s.k: Think of the summit, climb one step.
t: The Moon asks you for responsibility and vision. Think about what you want to build over the coming months.

Mars and Jupiter are together in {S:4}: courage and initiative, confidence and opportunities, all focused on pleasure, creativity and romance. Everything is concentrated in one place, so give it your full attention.
s.d: Keep a promise you made to yourself today.

t: A day to step out of your mental routine. Try a different path, even a small one.
Mars and Jupiter are together in {S:4}: courage and initiative, confidence and opportunities, all focused on home and family. Do not scatter yourself: one goal at a time.
s.d: Sign up for, or find out about, a course that interests you.

s.k: Let go of what no longer belongs to you.
t: The Moon passes through your deepest area. Emotions arrive with intensity, and with them the wish for truth.
Mars and Jupiter are together in {S:4}: courage and initiative, confidence and opportunities, all focused on conversations, contacts and short trips. It is a good day to start something in this area.
s.d: Trust a secret only to someone who has already proved worthy of it.

s.k: A day to get in step as a pair.
t: Today relationships need attention: a partner, an associate or a close friend needs to feel your presence.
Mars and Jupiter are together in {S:4}: courage and initiative, confidence and opportunities, all focused on your money and what you value. There is more intensity than usual, so take it easy.
s.d: Do not try to change the other person: try to understand them.

t: With the Moon in your house of daily work, practical tasks go well. Start with the one you keep putting off.

Mars and Jupiter are together in {S:4}: courage and initiative, confidence and opportunities, all focused on your image and your personal energy. The energy is all in one place: use it with intention.
s.d: Start the day with the hardest task and the rest will feel light.

s.k: A day to create, play and feel.
t: The Moon lights up love, children and the inner child we all have. Laugh more and worry less.
Mars and Jupiter are together in {S:4}: courage and initiative, confidence and opportunities, all focused on rest and your inner life. Listen to what this area has been asking of you for a while.
s.d: Laugh at yourself when something goes less well.

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: The Moon asks you for a safe harbour. If the day is hectic outside, create calm in your own space.
Mars and Jupiter are together in {S:4}: courage and initiative, confidence and opportunities, all focused on friends and plans for the future. What you do here today has more strength than usual.
s.d: Make peace with a childhood memory.

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: The Moon passes through your area of conversations: messages, calls and quick meetings set the pace of the day.
Mars and Jupiter are together in {S:4}: courage and initiative, confidence and opportunities, all focused on your career and your goals. A decision made today will stand on firm ground.
s.d: Apologise for a careless word, if need be.

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: Today the Moon asks for stability: whatever gives you security, be it money, home or affection, carries more weight.
Mars and Jupiter are together in {S:4}: courage and initiative, confidence and opportunities, all focused on study, travel and broad horizons. Focus, and leave the rest for tomorrow.
s.d: Put aside a small amount, just to build the habit.

t: The Moon in your sign asks you to put yourself at the centre of the day. It is not selfishness: it is recharging so you can give more to others.

Mars and Jupiter are together in {S:4}: courage and initiative, confidence and opportunities, all focused on intimacy and what you share with others. The sky points the way: all you have to do is follow it.
s.d: Look after your image: a haircut, a new piece of clothing or simply standing up straight.

t: The Moon asks you to close cycles calmly before starting new ones. Tidy up on the inside.
Mars and Jupiter are together in {S:4}: courage and initiative, confidence and opportunities, all focused on relationships and partnerships. A new beginning may be born from here.
s.d: Forgive yourself for something that is already in the past.

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
t: A day to feel part of something bigger. Call someone you have not spoken to in a while.
Mars and Jupiter are together in {S:4}: courage and initiative, confidence and opportunities, all focused on routine, daily work and health. This is where your strength lies today.
s.d: Picture your ideal future for five minutes, in detail.
